title: D365 Architect global choice list
description: Declarative YAML shape for a list of Dynamics global choices, produced by `d365architect choice export`. A field left out of this file was left at Dataverse's own default, not "unknown" — see each field's own description for what that default is. Editing this file back into Dataverse (via the matching `import` command) will leave an omitted field at that default rather than whatever it happened to be before.

name.description: The choice's unique name, e.g. "new_colors" — its stable identity (there's no separate internal id in this YAML, the way a form needs FormId): Dataverse's own Name never changes after creation, so it's always safe to look up by.

options.description: The choice's own values. Required to create a brand-new choice — see AttributeOptionDefinition for why a value is always explicit, never invented. Null on an update-only YAML means "don't touch the options", same as everywhere else in this tool.

value.description: The option's integer value, e.g. 727000000. Ignored for a Status option being newly inserted — see this class's own doc comment.

state.description: Status only: which State (0 = Active, 1 = Inactive, by Dataverse's own convention — a table can define more) this status reason belongs to. Required to insert a brand-new Status option — Dataverse's InsertStatusValue action needs it and this tool never guesses it — but not otherwise meaningful (Picklist/ MultiSelectPicklist/State options don't have one; a State option's own Value already is its state).
